Title: Change of Target and Hidden Lurker?

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Simple question: can I use HL after CoT?
HL says that combat must be over, which presumes the existence of combat,
but is that sentence binding or is it just defining the timing for HL to
be played?

In case you're wondering, I'm trying to build a Ventrue bleed/Samedi
bruise deck. ;-)

Oh, and another thing: CoT is only usable on a sucessfull block, but it
also cancels the action. Will Force of Will damage still apply (due to the
sucessfull block), or is it cancelled with the action?

Flux
(who never had enough CoT to worry about these things before)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Flux wrote:
> Simple question: can I use HL after CoT?

No. CoT cancels the action.
Action modifiers cannot be played after the action.
(Neither can reaction cards).

> HL says that combat must be over, which presumes the existence of combat,
> but is that sentence binding or is it just defining the timing for HL to
> be played?

This is also true - with no combat, HL couldn't be played (even if the
action was still going on).

> Oh, and another thing: CoT is only usable on a sucessfull block, but it
> also cancels the action. Will Force of Will damage still apply (due to the
> sucessfull block), or is it cancelled with the action?

Canceled.
